package.description: Package, share, and run complete apps as single portable .capsule files.

en-US.description: Package, share, and run complete apps as single portable .capsule files.
en-US.longDescription: Capsule packs an entire app - UI, data, media, and assets - into a single portable .capsule file that runs offline on the recipient's device. It can generate and update apps with AI: a simple prompt becomes a complete, self-contained desktop application with an HTML UI, a schema, and a local SQLite database, with no cloud servers or accounts. Capsules work with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and MCP coding tools, and can be shared like regular documents.
en-US.name: Capsule

zh-CN.description: 将完整应用打包为单个可移植的 .capsule 文件，随时分享与运行。
zh-CN.longDescription: Capsule 将整个应用（界面、数据、媒体和资源）打包为一个可移植的 .capsule 文件，可在接收者的设备上离线运行。它支持用 AI 生成和更新应用：一句简单的提示即可生成完整的自包含桌面应用，包含 HTML 界面、数据模式和本地 SQLite 数据库，无需云服务器或账号。Capsule 可与 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 以及 MCP 编码工具配合使用，并能像普通文档一样分享。
